meta.title: Entrust
meta.description: Please take my place. Finish what I could not.

units.rawText: As we draw closer to the Admin Center, the number of Entropics blocking our path grows.
units.displayText: As we draw closer to the Admin Center, the number of Entropics blocking our path grows.

spans.text: As we draw closer to the Admin Center, the number of Entropics blocking our path grows.

units.rawText: Though we've learned the movement patterns of the Entropics and don't need to fight so many of them at once, the repeated high-intensity battles are still very draining.
units.displayText: Though we've learned the movement patterns of the Entropics and don't need to fight so many of them at once, the repeated high-intensity battles are still very draining.

spans.text: Though we've learned the movement patterns of the Entropics and don't need to fight so many of them at once, the repeated high-intensity battles are still very draining.

units.rawText: Tsk... What a pain!
units.displayText: Tsk... What a pain!

spans.text: Tsk... What a pain!

units.rawText: Sol cuts off the tentacles reaching for her and carves a path through the purple tide ahead.
units.displayText: Sol cuts off the tentacles reaching for her and carves a path through the purple tide ahead.

spans.text: Sol cuts off the tentacles reaching for her and carves a path through the purple tide ahead.

units.rawText: We're almost there! Everyone, hang in there a little longer!
units.displayText: We're almost there! Everyone, hang in there a little longer!

spans.text: We're almost there! Everyone, hang in there a little longer!

units.rawText: Is that... the Admin Center?
units.displayText: Is that... the Admin Center?

spans.text: Is that... the Admin Center?

units.rawText: The building's exterior is crawling with Entropics and it's almost impossible to make out its original appearance. The darkened structure stands silently amidst a sea of Entropics and gleams with an ominous violet light.
units.displayText: The building's exterior is crawling with Entropics and it's almost impossible to make out its original appearance. The darkened structure stands silently amidst a sea of Entropics and gleams with an ominous violet light.

spans.text: The building's exterior is crawling with Entropics and it's almost impossible to make out its original appearance. The darkened structure stands silently amidst a sea of Entropics and gleams with an ominous violet light.

units.rawText: Dammit... This is just too much! Is the barrier control terminal in there still working?
units.displayText: Dammit... This is just too much! Is the barrier control terminal in there still working?

spans.text: Dammit... This is just too much! Is the barrier control terminal in there still working?

units.rawText: Yes, there is a firewall outside the Admin Center. They cannot break it for the time being.
units.displayText: Yes, there is a firewall outside the Admin Center. They cannot break it for the time being.

spans.text: Yes, there is a firewall outside the Admin Center. They cannot break it for the time being.

units.rawText: There are too many Entropics at the main entrance. I will take you to the back door... (Coughs)
units.displayText: There are too many Entropics at the main entrance. I will take you to the back door... (Coughs)

spans.text: There are too many Entropics at the main entrance. I will take you to the back door... (Coughs)

units.rawText: Taranum coughs violently and her body starts to turn transparent.
units.displayText: Taranum coughs violently and her body starts to turn transparent.

spans.text: Taranum coughs violently and her body starts to turn transparent.

units.rawText: Don't scare me, bookworm. Don't drop the ball at a time like this!
units.displayText: Don't scare me, bookworm. Don't drop the ball at a time like this!

spans.text: Don't scare me, bookworm. Don't drop the ball at a time like this!

units.rawText: Wait a minute, don't tell me...
units.displayText: Wait a minute, don't tell me...

spans.text: Wait a minute, don't tell me...

units.rawText: Antonina forces her way into Taranum's neural cloud.
units.displayText: Antonina forces her way into Taranum's neural cloud.

spans.text: Antonina forces her way into Taranum's neural cloud.

units.rawText: You're burning your own operands to fuel the firewall? And that tsunami just now...
units.displayText: You're burning your own operands to fuel the firewall? And that tsunami just now...

spans.text: You're burning your own operands to fuel the firewall? And that tsunami just now...

units.rawText: I thought you could reallocate the sector's operands! Why...
units.displayText: I thought you could reallocate the sector's operands! Why...

spans.text: I thought you could reallocate the sector's operands! Why...

units.rawText: (Coughs) Suppressing the Entropics is my top priority. I need to conserve the sector's operands...
units.displayText: (Coughs) Suppressing the Entropics is my top priority. I need to conserve the sector's operands...

spans.text: (Coughs) Suppressing the Entropics is my top priority. I need to conserve the sector's operands...

units.rawText: But you're fueling it with your own life force! Here, I'll transfer some operands to you...
units.displayText: But you're fueling it with your own life force! Here, I'll transfer some operands to you...

spans.text: But you're fueling it with your own life force! Here, I'll transfer some operands to you...

units.rawText: ...No good, I can't get around the Rewrite Program.
units.displayText: ...No good, I can't get around the Rewrite Program.

spans.text: ...No good, I can't get around the Rewrite Program.

units.rawText: Taranum, give me your hand.
units.displayText: Taranum, give me your hand.

spans.text: Taranum, give me your hand.

units.rawText: Hurry up, I'll carry you. I don't know what your priorities are, but I don't want to see you die here!
units.displayText: Hurry up, I'll carry you. I don't know what your priorities are, but I don't want to see you die here!

spans.text: Hurry up, I'll carry you. I don't know what your priorities are, but I don't want to see you die here!

units.rawText: ...Okay.
units.displayText: ...Okay.

spans.text: ...Okay.

units.rawText: It's just up ahead.
units.displayText: It's just up ahead.

spans.text: It's just up ahead.

units.rawText: Is that the back door? Looks like it hasn't been used in a long time.
units.displayText: Is that the back door? Looks like it hasn't been used in a long time.

spans.text: Is that the back door? Looks like it hasn't been used in a long time.

units.rawText: It's a special passage used by researchers to transport simulated lifeform specimens. Once, many agents...
units.displayText: It's a special passage used by researchers to transport simulated lifeform specimens. Once, many agents...

spans.text: It's a special passage used by researchers to transport simulated lifeform specimens. Once, many agents...

units.rawText: Taranum trails off. She looks like she's in pain from being hit.
units.displayText: Taranum trails off. She looks like she's in pain from being hit.

spans.text: Taranum trails off. She looks like she's in pain from being hit.

units.rawText: Many agents? So there were other agents in this sector besides you?
units.displayText: Many agents? So there were other agents in this sector besides you?

spans.text: Many agents? So there were other agents in this sector besides you?

units.rawText: No... comment...
units.displayText: No... comment...

spans.text: No... comment...

units.rawText: Taranum turns away from Sol's gaze. Her movements are very awkward and she almost falls to the ground. Antonina manages to reach out in time to support her.
units.displayText: Taranum turns away from Sol's gaze. Her movements are very awkward and she almost falls to the ground. Antonina manages to reach out in time to support her.

spans.text: Taranum turns away from Sol's gaze. Her movements are very awkward and she almost falls to the ground. Antonina manages to reach out in time to support her.

units.rawText: This is bad. It looks like she's having trouble functioning.
units.displayText: This is bad. It looks like she's having trouble functioning.

spans.text: This is bad. It looks like she's having trouble functioning.

units.rawText: Let's just get inside the Admin Center first!
units.displayText: Let's just get inside the Admin Center first!

spans.text: Let's just get inside the Admin Center first!

units.rawText: Wait! Look out for that patch of simulated greenery!
units.displayText: Wait! Look out for that patch of simulated greenery!

spans.text: Wait! Look out for that patch of simulated greenery!

units.rawText: Hiss!
units.displayText: Hiss!

spans.text: Hiss!

units.rawText: A small pack of Entropics leap out of the simulated foliage just as Antonina gives her warning.
units.displayText: A small pack of Entropics leap out of the simulated foliage just as Antonina gives her warning.

spans.text: A small pack of Entropics leap out of the simulated foliage just as Antonina gives her warning.

units.rawText: These monsters... Hey, bookworm, are you okay!?
units.displayText: These monsters... Hey, bookworm, are you okay!?

spans.text: These monsters... Hey, bookworm, are you okay!?

units.rawText: I'm fine. Put me down, I'm just slowing you down.
units.displayText: I'm fine. Put me down, I'm just slowing you down.

spans.text: I'm fine. Put me down, I'm just slowing you down.

units.rawText: Are you kidding me. Your little bit of weight is a piece of cake for me!
units.displayText: Are you kidding me. Your little bit of weight is a piece of cake for me!

spans.text: Are you kidding me. Your little bit of weight is a piece of cake for me!

units.rawText: Sol draws her weapons to intercept the enemy and Antonina summons up her operand to strike down the lead Twiner.
units.displayText: Sol draws her weapons to intercept the enemy and Antonina summons up her operand to strike down the lead Twiner.

spans.text: Sol draws her weapons to intercept the enemy and Antonina summons up her operand to strike down the lead Twiner.

units.rawText: But soon, an endless stream of Entropic ambushers starts pouring out of the virtual vegetation.
units.displayText: But soon, an endless stream of Entropic ambushers starts pouring out of the virtual vegetation.

spans.text: But soon, an endless stream of Entropic ambushers starts pouring out of the virtual vegetation.

units.rawText: We can use those simulated rocks as cover! Let's fall back there first!
units.displayText: We can use those simulated rocks as cover! Let's fall back there first!

spans.text: We can use those simulated rocks as cover! Let's fall back there first!

units.rawText: We set up a fighting position behind the rocks, but instead of pursuing us, the Entropics guard the back entrance, as though they're certain we'll try to break into the Admin Center again.
units.displayText: We set up a fighting position behind the rocks, but instead of pursuing us, the Entropics guard the back entrance, as though they're certain we'll try to break into the Admin Center again.

spans.text: We set up a fighting position behind the rocks, but instead of pursuing us, the Entropics guard the back entrance, as though they're certain we'll try to break into the Admin Center again.

units.rawText: While there aren't as many here as the front door, these numbers are still a huge pain...
units.displayText: While there aren't as many here as the front door, these numbers are still a huge pain...

spans.text: While there aren't as many here as the front door, these numbers are still a huge pain...

units.rawText: The Entropics here can use tactics. This might be an important point.
units.displayText: The Entropics here can use tactics. This might be an important point.

spans.text: The Entropics here can use tactics. This might be an important point.

units.rawText: If I'm not mistaken, they aren't from the same batch as the undersea Entropics.
units.displayText: If I'm not mistaken, they aren't from the same batch as the undersea Entropics.

spans.text: If I'm not mistaken, they aren't from the same batch as the undersea Entropics.

units.rawText: You're right. They're different in appearance and their code redundancy is also different. More importantly, they're much better fighters than the undersea Entropics.
units.displayText: You're right. They're different in appearance and their code redundancy is also different. More importantly, they're much better fighters than the undersea Entropics.

spans.text: You're right. They're different in appearance and their code redundancy is also different. More importantly, they're much better fighters than the undersea Entropics.

units.rawText: These Entropics are very similar to the ones we encountered in the Art Sector.
units.displayText: These Entropics are very similar to the ones we encountered in the Art Sector.

spans.text: These Entropics are very similar to the ones we encountered in the Art Sector.

units.rawText: The art sector... So these are Odile's Entropics? So she's been waiting inside the Admin Center to ambush us all this time!
units.displayText: The art sector... So these are Odile's Entropics? So she's been waiting inside the Admin Center to ambush us all this time!

spans.text: The art sector... So these are Odile's Entropics? So she's been waiting inside the Admin Center to ambush us all this time!

units.rawText: Dammit, why do I get the feeling she anticipates every move we make!?
units.displayText: Dammit, why do I get the feeling she anticipates every move we make!?

spans.text: Dammit, why do I get the feeling she anticipates every move we make!?

units.rawText: Anna, can't you backtrace her or something and use these Entropics to find where that Odile is!?
units.displayText: Anna, can't you backtrace her or something and use these Entropics to find where that Odile is!?

spans.text: Anna, can't you backtrace her or something and use these Entropics to find where that Odile is!?

units.rawText: The Entropics operate in a top-down tree-like structure. If Demiurge dies, Odile will probably end up briefly incapacitated without a superior's commands.
units.displayText: The Entropics operate in a top-down tree-like structure. If Demiurge dies, Odile will probably end up briefly incapacitated without a superior's commands.

spans.text: The Entropics operate in a top-down tree-like structure. If Demiurge dies, Odile will probably end up briefly incapacitated without a superior's commands.

units.rawText: Unless... No, that's not likely.
units.displayText: Unless... No, that's not likely.

spans.text: Unless... No, that's not likely.

units.rawText: Without a superior's commands... Does that mean Odile might return to how she was when we first met her?
units.displayText: Without a superior's commands... Does that mean Odile might return to how she was when we first met her?

spans.text: Without a superior's commands... Does that mean Odile might return to how she was when we first met her?

units.rawText: It might be worth a try.
units.displayText: It might be worth a try.

spans.text: It might be worth a try.

units.rawText: In any case, we'll have plenty of time to find Odile after we take out Demiurge.
units.displayText: In any case, we'll have plenty of time to find Odile after we take out Demiurge.

spans.text: In any case, we'll have plenty of time to find Odile after we take out Demiurge.

units.rawText: Sweet! In other words, once we get into the Admin Center and get the barrier going, everything will be settled, is that it?
units.displayText: Sweet! In other words, once we get into the Admin Center and get the barrier going, everything will be settled, is that it?

spans.text: Sweet! In other words, once we get into the Admin Center and get the barrier going, everything will be settled, is that it?

units.rawText: Hey, bookworm! Tell me how to get in, I'll force my way through!
units.displayText: Hey, bookworm! Tell me how to get in, I'll force my way through!

spans.text: Hey, bookworm! Tell me how to get in, I'll force my way through!

units.rawText: You need administrator access to open the back door.
units.displayText: You need administrator access to open the back door.

spans.text: You need administrator access to open the back door.

units.rawText: In other words, Taranum has to open the back door... It's too difficult for just the few of us to cover her in an ocean of Entropics.
units.displayText: In other words, Taranum has to open the back door... It's too difficult for just the few of us to cover her in an ocean of Entropics.

spans.text: In other words, Taranum has to open the back door... It's too difficult for just the few of us to cover her in an ocean of Entropics.

units.rawText: ...How long would it take to get to the Admin Center if there were no Entropics around?
units.displayText: ...How long would it take to get to the Admin Center if there were no Entropics around?

spans.text: ...How long would it take to get to the Admin Center if there were no Entropics around?

units.rawText: It'd be hard even without Entropics. I'd need 5 seconds.... Er, if I'm carrying you, then... 10 seconds, tops!
units.displayText: It'd be hard even without Entropics. I'd need 5 seconds.... Er, if I'm carrying you, then... 10 seconds, tops!

spans.text: It'd be hard even without Entropics. I'd need 5 seconds.... Er, if I'm carrying you, then... 10 seconds, tops!

units.rawText: Understood. I'll be counting on you, then.
units.displayText: Understood. I'll be counting on you, then.

spans.text: Understood. I'll be counting on you, then.

units.rawText: What...
units.displayText: What...

spans.text: What...

units.rawText: A sudden, violent gust of wind whips past us, and part of the Entropics guarding the back door are swept up into the sky.
units.displayText: A sudden, violent gust of wind whips past us, and part of the Entropics guarding the back door are swept up into the sky.

spans.text: A sudden, violent gust of wind whips past us, and part of the Entropics guarding the back door are swept up into the sky.

units.rawText: Taranum tightens her grip on Sol's back and speaks quietly.
units.displayText: Taranum tightens her grip on Sol's back and speaks quietly.

spans.text: Taranum tightens her grip on Sol's back and speaks quietly.

units.rawText: You have... 10 seconds...
units.displayText: You have... 10 seconds...

spans.text: You have... 10 seconds...

units.rawText: Go! Sol, take out the remaining Entropics! Anna, support her from behind!
units.displayText: Go! Sol, take out the remaining Entropics! Anna, support her from behind!

spans.text: Go! Sol, take out the remaining Entropics! Anna, support her from behind!

units.rawText: We break into a run toward the Admin Center, practically on instinct. Sol's burning blades sweep away the few remaining Entropics. After Taranum's access is accepted, the back door slowly begins to open.
units.displayText: We break into a run toward the Admin Center, practically on instinct. Sol's burning blades sweep away the few remaining Entropics. After Taranum's access is accepted, the back door slowly begins to open.

spans.text: We break into a run toward the Admin Center, practically on instinct. Sol's burning blades sweep away the few remaining Entropics. After Taranum's access is accepted, the back door slowly begins to open.

units.rawText: Everyone, get inside!
units.displayText: Everyone, get inside!

spans.text: Everyone, get inside!

units.rawText:
After ensuring that we're all inside the Admin Center, Sol bars the door from her position at the rear of the group.
At last, those bestial howls are safely kept out.
units.displayText:

units.rawText: Hey, bookworm!? Wake up!
units.displayText: Hey, bookworm!? Wake up!

spans.text: Hey, bookworm!? Wake up!

units.displayText: Taranum can no longer support her own body and Sol gently lays her on the ground.

spans.text: Taranum can no longer support her own body and Sol gently lays her on the ground.

units.rawText: ...You did it.
units.displayText: ...You did it.

spans.text: ...You did it.

units.rawText: Did you draw on your own operand to activate a weather control command!? You're already...
units.displayText: Did you draw on your own operand to activate a weather control command!? You're already...

spans.text: Did you draw on your own operand to activate a weather control command!? You're already...

units.rawText: It's fine... This... is what I want...
units.displayText: It's fine... This... is what I want...

spans.text: It's fine... This... is what I want...

units.rawText: Wake up! Anna, give her my operand!
units.displayText: Wake up! Anna, give her my operand!

spans.text: Wake up! Anna, give her my operand!

units.rawText: I told you, her operands comes from the Rewrite Program. Only the person controlling her is authorized to transfer operands to her.
units.displayText: I told you, her operands comes from the Rewrite Program. Only the person controlling her is authorized to transfer operands to her.

spans.text: I told you, her operands comes from the Rewrite Program. Only the person controlling her is authorized to transfer operands to her.

units.rawText: But she kept drawing on herself like this with no operand transfers to make up the shortfall... She can't function on her own anymore, to say nothing of operating the barrier control terminal.
units.displayText: But she kept drawing on herself like this with no operand transfers to make up the shortfall... She can't function on her own anymore, to say nothing of operating the barrier control terminal.

spans.text: But she kept drawing on herself like this with no operand transfers to make up the shortfall... She can't function on her own anymore, to say nothing of operating the barrier control terminal.

units.rawText: Why you... Hey, didn't you want to wipe out the Entropics in this sector!? Don't go nodding off on me!
units.displayText: Why you... Hey, didn't you want to wipe out the Entropics in this sector!? Don't go nodding off on me!

spans.text: Why you... Hey, didn't you want to wipe out the Entropics in this sector!? Don't go nodding off on me!

units.rawText: Please... Everyone...
units.displayText: Please... Everyone...

spans.text: Please... Everyone...

units.rawText: Take... my permissions...
units.displayText: Take... my permissions...

spans.text: Take... my permissions...

units.rawText: Use my administrator access... to operate the control terminal...
units.displayText: Use my administrator access... to operate the control terminal...

spans.text: Use my administrator access... to operate the control terminal...

units.rawText: No good, the administrator access is bound to the Rewrite Program.
units.displayText: No good, the administrator access is bound to the Rewrite Program.

spans.text: No good, the administrator access is bound to the Rewrite Program.

units.rawText: Then... get rid of it...
units.displayText: Then... get rid of it...

spans.text: Then... get rid of it...

units.rawText: ...Do you know what you're saying?
units.displayText: ...Do you know what you're saying?

spans.text: ...Do you know what you're saying?

units.rawText: If we directly delete the Rewrite Program, you will become an empty shell.
units.displayText: If we directly delete the Rewrite Program, you will become an empty shell.

spans.text: If we directly delete the Rewrite Program, you will become an empty shell.

units.rawText: That's fine...
units.displayText: That's fine...

spans.text: That's fine...

units.rawText: Priority 1... Suppress the Entropics...
units.displayText: Priority 1... Suppress the Entropics...

spans.text: Priority 1... Suppress the Entropics...

units.rawText: Priority 2... Protect the Rewrite Program...
units.displayText: Priority 2... Protect the Rewrite Program...

spans.text: Priority 2... Protect the Rewrite Program...

units.rawText: According to my priorities... I should abandon the Rewrite Program... and transfer administrator access...
units.displayText: According to my priorities... I should abandon the Rewrite Program... and transfer administrator access...

spans.text: According to my priorities... I should abandon the Rewrite Program... and transfer administrator access...

units.rawText: No, how could we...
units.displayText: No, how could we...

spans.text: No, how could we...

units.rawText: Taranum squeezes Sol's hand.
units.displayText: Taranum squeezes Sol's hand.

spans.text: Taranum squeezes Sol's hand.

units.rawText: I've been waiting... for this day...
units.displayText: I've been waiting... for this day...

spans.text: I've been waiting... for this day...

units.rawText: So please... Grant my wish...
units.displayText: So please... Grant my wish...

spans.text: So please... Grant my wish...

units.rawText: But, but you'll disappear...
units.displayText: But, but you'll disappear...

spans.text: But, but you'll disappear...

units.rawText:
Bang! Bang!
Outside, the Entropics are assaulting the main door, which has lost the protection of its firewall.
units.displayText:
Bang! Bang!

Outside, the Entropics are assaulting the main door, which has lost the protection of its firewall.

units.rawText: The Entropics will be in here any minute now.
units.displayText: The Entropics will be in here any minute now.

spans.text: The Entropics will be in here any minute now.

units.rawText: I understand.
units.displayText: I understand.

spans.text: I understand.

units.rawText: I know that ideally, you'd leave nobody behind, but in reality...
units.displayText: I know that ideally, you'd leave nobody behind, but in reality...

spans.text: I know that ideally, you'd leave nobody behind, but in reality...

units.rawText: In reality, we have to make a choice now or we'll lose even more!
units.displayText: In reality, we have to make a choice now or we'll lose even more!

spans.text: In reality, we have to make a choice now or we'll lose even more!

units.rawText: Ideals... They're called ideals because they can't be completely fulfilled. I know that now.
units.displayText: Ideals... They're called ideals because they can't be completely fulfilled. I know that now.

spans.text: Ideals... They're called ideals because they can't be completely fulfilled. I know that now.

units.rawText: She chose to ask you for this favor in the end, so...

spans.text: She chose to ask you for this favor in the end, so...

Bang! Bang! Bang!
The Entropic attack is growing fiercer.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: ... I understand. Do it, Anna.
units.displayText: ... I understand. Do it, Anna.

spans.text: ... I understand. Do it, Anna.

units.rawText: Once Sol has given the word, we finally see a smile on Taranum's face for the first time.
units.displayText: Once Sol has given the word, we finally see a smile on Taranum's face for the first time.

spans.text: Once Sol has given the word, we finally see a smile on Taranum's face for the first time.

units.rawText: If you can... please bring me to the administrator's... room.
units.displayText: If you can... please bring me to the administrator's... room.

spans.text: If you can... please bring me to the administrator's... room.

units.rawText: I want to... be with those memories...
units.displayText: I want to... be with those memories...

spans.text: I want to... be with those memories...

units.rawText: Thank... you...
units.displayText: Thank... you...

spans.text: Thank... you...

units.rawText:
Without the Rewrite Program binding her, Taranum also loses the final bit of operand support that was keeping her going.
However, just before her eyes close for good, they look neither clouded nor demented. In fact, they are clearer than they have ever been before.
